cases.name: 带 WHERE 条件
cases.sql: SELECT id, name FROM users WHERE age > 18

cases.name: INNER JOIN 连接查询
cases.sql: SELECT u.name, o.total FROM users u INNER JOIN orders o ON u.id = o.user_id

cases.name: WHERE 子查询
cases.sql: SELECT name FROM users WHERE id IN (SELECT user_id FROM orders WHERE total > 100)

cases.name: FROM 派生表
cases.sql: SELECT t.name, t.cnt FROM (SELECT name, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM users GROUP BY name) t

cases.name: CTE 公共表表达式
cases.sql: WITH stats AS (SELECT user_id, COUNT(*) AS c FROM orders GROUP BY user_id) SELECT u.name, s.c FROM users u JOIN stats s ON u.id = s.user_id

cases.name: 聚合 + HAVING
cases.sql: SELECT category, COUNT(*), AVG(price) FROM products GROUP BY category HAVING COUNT(*) > 5 ORDER BY 2 DESC

cases.name: 窗口函数
cases.sql: SELECT name, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY salary DESC) FROM employees

cases.name: UNION 集合查询
cases.sql: SELECT id FROM users UNION SELECT id FROM orders

cases.name: CASE 表达式
cases.sql: SELECT name, CASE WHEN age < 18 THEN 'minor' ELSE 'adult' END FROM users

cases.name: 时间区间过滤
cases.sql: SELECT * FROM orders WHERE created_at > NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days'

cases.name: ILIKE 模糊搜索

cases.name: 安全内置函数
cases.sql: SELECT COALESCE(nickname, name, 'unknown'), EXTRACT(YEAR FROM created_at) FROM users
